theorem lg_target (G : Type u) [Group G] [Finite G] : CategoryTheory.Limits.HasColimitsOfShape (CategoryTheory.SingleObj G) FintypeCat := by
  -- The category FintypeCat has all finite colimits, so it has colimits of shape SingleObj G
  -- since SingleObj G is a finite category (it has one object and no non-identity morphisms)
  -- and hence the result follows from the general result that if a category has finite colimits,
  -- then it has colimits of shape any finite category.
  apply CategoryTheory.Limits.hasColimitsOfShape_of_hasFiniteColimits
  refine ⟨FintypeCat, inferInstance, _, _⟩
  exact inferInstance
  exact inferInstance
